acceptance_contract.qualification: Definitions are binding and machine-oriented, but their future implementations and predicates have not been built or evaluated.

sections.definition: Define every node kind, required fields, stable node ID, and prohibited synthetic fields.
Every node kind requires exact source coordinate, source hash, TU identity, and owning declaration or function.
Canonical symbol identity combines qualified declaration identity, signature, source identity, and linkage scope.
Overloads are distinct by canonical parameter and cv/ref/template signature.
Primary templates, specializations, and materialized instantiations have distinct stable identities.
Duplicate declarations are reconciled only with equivalent canonical declarations; conflicting definitions block closure.
A provenance path is an ordered root-to-consumer edge sequence with matching endpoints and source-backed transitions.
Only declared edge-kind compositions may propagate provenance; direct synthetic root-to-unit attachment is forbidden.
Static reachability means a source-backed call/configuration path under the declared closed-world configuration, never filename inference.
The future configuration manifest must fix enabled processes, showers, remnants, pointer roles, and disabled modules before graph interpretation.
Every excluded module requires a source-backed proof that no required configuration path depends on it.
External calls require a typed signature, modeled argument/return effect, or blocking EXTERNAL_LIBRARY_BOUNDARY.
Callbacks and function pointers require a closed target set or blocking FUNCTION_POINTER_UNRESOLVED.
A material miss is any omitted source-backed PDF-derived path affecting hard, ISR, remnant, selection, ratio, envelope, or weight semantics.
Boundary/policy exemptions require an independent reviewer, exact source evidence, rationale, and non-dataflow justification.
Macro-generated evidence records spelling and expansion identities and blocks when either coordinate cannot be stabilized.
A virtual target set is closed only when corpus, class hierarchy, construction sites, and configuration exclusions are proven complete.
Neutral wrappers and registration tables are discovered from typed call/assignment/registration relations, not names.
Predeclared node, edge, memory, and serialized-byte caps stop with an explicit incomplete result when exceeded.
Any timeout, depth limit, dropped TU, or truncation is serialized and blocks completeness.
The total unresolved-record cap is predeclared; exceeding it blocks the evidence task rather than dropping records.
Required hard-process, ISR, and remnant paths each require zero unresolved binding records.
The reviewer must not author graph-construction rules or curate the construction input and must reproduce from pinned inputs.
The 672-member holdout stays inaccessible to construction and is evaluated only after graph serialization is frozen.
Every binding gate names deterministic input fields, a machine predicate, expected value, and failure output.

acceptance_gates.requirement: Authoritative source identity, inventory, mirrors, and exclusions reproduce exactly.
All 120 required translation units parse; one miss is a blocking failure.
Canonical compile argv and environment replay with exact set and byte equality.
All required roots arise from typed declarations, definitions, or assignments.
Identifier, filename, historical, global, and synthetic fallback counts are zero.
Every graph edge has exact source support and valid composition.
Argument-to-parameter and return-to-caller flows are implemented and tested.
Member and cache writes connect to reads across functions without spelling inference.
Aliases, callbacks, and virtual targets resolve or block completeness.
All sixteen BeamSetup PDF pointer roles have local typed installation/accounting paths.
PDF-object alpha_s providers and routing paths are represented or block closure.
Hard-process NC, ISR/backward-evolution, and remnant paths are represented.
The 672-member holdout has zero binding unresolved and not-recovered entries.
All generic-name and co-located-occurrence controls pass.
Independent neutral-name/interprocedural recall finds no material miss.
Two independent graph generations serialize byte-identically.
An independent reviewer reproduces source, commands, graph, and calibration.
Runtime-only limitations remain unresolved and never satisfy a static gate.

optional_feature_configuration.policy: Expand and re-review the corpus before claiming a path that depends on a disabled module.

per_translation_unit_overrides.source_evidence: XMLDIR is used unconditionally by Pythia.cc and supplied by the upstream Makefile.
The upstream FJcore build definition changes limited-thread-safety semantics.

cost_bound.interpretation: These ranges challenge feasibility; they are not precise project scheduling commitments.

failure_scope: INCONCLUSIVE rejects the current boundedness and compile-contract claims; it does not prove all future typed source-analysis methods impossible.

false_negative_challenge.material_miss_definition: Any omitted source-backed PDF-derived path affecting hard, ISR, remnant, selection, ratio, envelope, or weight semantics.

acceptance_contract_complete.rationale: Twenty-five binding definitions exist, but their schemas and predicates are not implemented or evaluated.

alias_dispatch_policy_complete.rationale: Alias, callback, function-pointer, and virtual closed-world policies are defined but unevaluated.

calibration_contract_complete.rationale: The holdout remains post-construction and blinded with zero binding misses.

compile_contract_supported.rationale: Source inspection corrected two per-TU definitions, but exact commands have not been generated or parsed.

corpus_identity_supported.rationale: Official PYTHIA identity and the 247-file manifest inventory reproduced.

false_negative_contract_complete.rationale: Material-miss and independent challenge classes are explicit.

implementation_cost_bounded.rationale: The independent 15.2/30.6/57.4-week challenge does not support the eight-week cap.

independent_review_cost_bounded.rationale: Two weeks is nominally plausible but the pessimistic range is three weeks.

interprocedural_plan_complete.rationale: Cross-TU identity, overload, call, parameter, and return rules are defined but unimplemented.

member_cache_plan_complete.rationale: Member/cache source-path requirements are defined but unimplemented.

relation_representation_supported.rationale: Clang supplies typed anchors; repository cross-TU and dataflow relations remain unimplemented.

scientific_contract_unchanged.rationale: The accepted PDF family, support, sign, and inference contracts remain unchanged.

source_lineage_portable_or_explicitly_qu.rationale: Clean CI is explicitly limited to committed-manifest and artifact reproducibility.

static_runtime_boundary_complete.rationale: Runtime-only properties cannot satisfy static closure.

stop_conditions_machine_checkable.rationale: Each stop condition names a future machine predicate.

toolchain_identity_supported.rationale: LLVM 18.1.8 identity is pinned; preference is not selection.

typed_root_contract_complete.rationale: Typed root classes and prohibitions are specified with source-evidence requirements.

negative_controls.required_proof: The exact occurrence must lie on a typed, source-backed provenance path.

next_step.condition: Only a later explicit decision may authorize a separately scoped static-evidence implementation task.

non_failure_scope: AST evidence may still repair provenance integrity, but does not establish graph completeness, signed-rate mathematics, runtime reachability, generator compatibility, or implementation permission.

objective.scientific_objective_unchanged: p(theta_PDF | D), where D is a set of events
objective.task: Assess whether a separately reviewed AST-grounded PYTHIA PDF-consumer graph task is technically bounded and scientifically useful.

preferred_feasibility_candidate.reason: Typed AST anchors remain scientifically relevant, but cross-TU/dataflow implementation, compile replay, and cost are not bounded.

stop_conditions.condition: Any required translation unit cannot be parsed reproducibly.
Source-backed interprocedural or member flow remains incomplete after a separately approved bound.
Holdout or independent challenge exposes a material miss that cannot be bounded.
Construction uses identifier, filename, global, historical, or synthetic fallback.
Any timeout, truncation, ODR conflict, or required unresolved path remains.

runtime_only_properties.later_evidence: Separately authorized configuration-specific runtime pointer identity trace.
Reviewed configuration plus separately authorized runtime target observation.
Separately authorized concurrency and lifecycle validation.

acquisition_and_pinning_strategy.method: A future separately authorized task would obtain llvmorg-18.1.8 and verify the peeled commit before installation.

alias_pointer_analysis.future_requirement: Propagate only source-supported points-to facts and serialize every remaining alias as blocking.
alias_pointer_analysis.limitation: General alias closure and post-init pointer replacement cannot be proven statically.

cxx_language_and_templates.future_requirement: Repository analysis must identify specializations across TUs and fail closed on an unmaterialized required instance.
cxx_language_and_templates.limitation: Cross-TU specialization identity and unmaterialized instances are not supplied as a complete graph.
cxx_language_and_templates.primary_evidence: Clang exposes typed declarations and materialized template instances for parsed C++11 translation units.

deterministic_serialization.future_requirement: Define canonical cross-TU symbol IDs, ordering, normalization, and byte equality.
deterministic_serialization.limitation: Traversal order and compiler-internal identifiers are not stable artifact identities.
deterministic_serialization.primary_evidence: Typed declarations and coordinates provide possible stable anchors.

dynamic_dispatch.future_requirement: Construct source-backed candidate sets under explicit closed-world conditions and block every open set.
dynamic_dispatch.limitation: Runtime-selected concrete targets cannot be statically proven by this record.
dynamic_dispatch.primary_evidence: Clang anchors typed virtual calls and class declarations.

field_member_dataflow.future_requirement: Index field identity and source-supported writes and reads across the corpus.
field_member_dataflow.limitation: Cross-function member and cache write/read flow is not automatic.
field_member_dataflow.primary_evidence: Clang anchors field declarations and member expressions with static types.
